messages.content: Answer from cited policy evidence only.
Can I return an opened blender that arrived defective? Order placed 2026-05-10.

evidence.citation: returns-policy v2 | Return policy > Opened products | chars 257-728 | sha 44dde78d3672
evidence.text:
## Opened products

Opened products cannot be returned. This includes items whose seal, box or protective film has been removed, and items that have been assembled, installed or used.

The following conditions are exempt from this rule:

| Condition | Returnable | Window |
|---|---|---|
| Defective or damaged on arrival | Yes | 90 days from delivery |
| Missing parts or accessories | Yes | 30 days from delivery |
| Wrong item shipped | Yes | 30 days from delivery |

evidence.citation: shipping v4 | Shipping and delivery > Damaged packages | chars 152-291 | sha a89fca74168d
evidence.text:
## Damaged packages

If a package arrives damaged, keep the packaging and report it within 48 hours so that a carrier claim can be opened.

evidence.citation: warranty v1 | Manufacturer warranty > Coverage | chars 25-206 | sha 1797b6d2f52d
evidence.text:
## Coverage

Most products carry a 12-month manufacturer warranty from the date of purchase. Warranty service for a defective product is repair or replacement by the manufacturer.

Unopened products may be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Start a return from the order page or contact support with the order number.

messages.content: Yes. Opened products are normally not returnable, but a product that is defective or damaged on arrival can be returned within 90 days of delivery [E1].
